## clusterProfiler

```{r gsea-methods, results='asis'}
if (is_lrt) {
  cat("\n\nOver-representation analysis (ORA) of **degPatterns** gene clusters ",
      "from each LRT, against every requested MSigDB collection ",
      "(top pathways by adjusted p-value).\n\n", sep = "")
  deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce cluster ORA with:",
    "ora <- run_cluster_ora_pipeline(degpatterns_out, universe = rownames(dds_qc))"
  )
} else {
  cat("\n\nGene-set enrichment on the DESeq2 ranked gene list for each contrast, ",
      "run independently against every requested MSigDB collection.\n\n", sep = "")
  deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce pathway enrichment with this package module:",
    "gsea_out <- run_gsea_pipeline(",
    "  diffexp_out$results,",
    "  collections = c(\"HALLMARK\", \"GOBP\", \"REACTOME\")",
    ")"
  )
}
```

```{r gsea-helpers, include=FALSE}
emit_gsea_contrast <- function(comp, by_coll, by_coll_cp = NULL,
                               coll_heading = "#####",
                               from_contrast_dir = FALSE) {
  ranks <- params$gsea_out$ranks_by_comparison[[comp]]
  gene_sets_all <- params$gsea_out$gene_sets
  for (coll in names(by_coll)) {
    cat("\n\n", coll_heading, " Collection: ", coll, "\n\n", sep = "")
    gsea_df <- by_coll[[coll]]
    if (is.null(gsea_df) || nrow(gsea_df) == 0) {
      cat("\n\nNo pathways returned.\n\n")
      next
    }
    p <- tryCatch(deseq2reports::plot_gsea_barplot(gsea_df, top_n = 10, title = comp),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(p)) {
      sz <- attr(p, "plot_size")
      if (is.null(sz)) sz <- list(width = 6.5, height = 5)
      deseq2reports::emit_plot_with_download(
        p, filename = paste(comp, coll, "gsea_barplot", sep = "_"),
        width = sz$width, height = sz$height, dpi = 120
      )
    }

    if (!is.null(ranks) && !is.null(gene_sets_all[[coll]])) {
      cat("\n\nGene enrichment barcode for the same top/bottom pathways ",
          "(pathway names left; member genes marked along the ranked list; ",
          "red = pathway NES > 0, blue = NES < 0; padj and NES on the right):\n\n",
          sep = "")
      p_bc <- tryCatch(
        deseq2reports::plot_gsea_barcode_panel(
          gsea_df, ranks = ranks, gene_sets = gene_sets_all[[coll]],
          top_n = 10, title = comp
        ),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (!is.null(p_bc)) {
        sz_bc <- attr(p_bc, "plot_size")
        if (is.null(sz_bc)) sz_bc <- list(width = 4.25, height = 2.25)
        deseq2reports::emit_plot_with_download(
          p_bc, filename = paste(comp, coll, "gsea_barcode", sep = "_"),
          width = sz_bc$width, height = sz_bc$height, dpi = 120
        )
      }
    }

    cat("\n\nTop 10 up- and top 10 down-regulated pathways by normalized enrichment score (NES), ",
        "shown regardless of significance; ",
        "significance stars: `*` padj < 0.05, `**` < 0.01, `***` < 0.001. ",
        "`leadingEdge` lists the driving genes for each pathway. Sort by any column or search ",
        "by pathway using the box below. The full GSEA CSV is linked beside the table.\n\n", sep = "")
    top_bottom_gsea <- deseq2reports::gsea_top_bottom_table(gsea_df, top_n = 10)
    coll_label <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", coll)
    gsea_csv <- if (from_contrast_dir) {
      file.path("gsea", paste0(coll_label, "_gsea.csv"))
    } else {
      file.path(comp, "gsea", paste0(coll_label, "_gsea.csv"))
    }
    gsea_btn <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(gsea_csv, label = "Download full CSV")
    deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(deseq2reports::make_gsea_datatable(top_bottom_gsea), gsea_btn)

    if (!is.null(by_coll_cp) && !is.null(by_coll_cp[[coll]])) {
      cat("\n\nA parallel `clusterProfiler::GSEA()` run against the same ranked gene list ",
          "and gene sets is also available (unfiltered `gseaResult` object and CSV export, ",
          "written alongside the `fgsea`-based results above).\n\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}

emit_ora_lrt <- function(lrt_label, from_contrast_dir = FALSE) {
  ora_by_cl <- params$cluster_ora_out$ora_by_lrt[[lrt_label]]
  plots_by_cl <- params$cluster_ora_out$plots_by_lrt[[lrt_label]]
  if (is.null(ora_by_cl) || !length(ora_by_cl)) {
    cat("\n\nNo cluster ORA results for this LRT.\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Nested Bootstrap tabs: outer = cluster, inner = MSigDB collection.
  # Dotplots are ~35% smaller than the previous 9 x 4.8" footprint.
  ora_w <- 9 * 0.65
  ora_h <- 4.8 * 0.65
  cl_labels <- paste0("Cluster ", names(ora_by_cl))
  cl_panes <- deseq2reports::bs_tabset_start(
    paste0("ora-clusters-", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "-", lrt_label)),
    cl_labels
  )
  for (i in seq_along(names(ora_by_cl))) {
    cl <- names(ora_by_cl)[i]
    deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_start(cl_panes[i], active = (i == 1L))

    coll_names <- names(ora_by_cl[[cl]])
    if (!length(coll_names)) {
      cat("<p>No collections for this cluster.</p>\n")
      deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_end()
      next
    }
    coll_panes <- deseq2reports::bs_tabset_start(
      paste0("ora-coll-", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "-", lrt_label), "-c", cl),
      coll_names
    )
    for (j in seq_along(coll_names)) {
      coll <- coll_names[j]
      deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_start(coll_panes[j], active = (j == 1L))
      res <- ora_by_cl[[cl]][[coll]]
      p <- if (!is.null(plots_by_cl)) plots_by_cl[[cl]][[coll]] else NULL
      if (!is.null(p)) {
        deseq2reports::emit_plot_with_download(
          p, filename = paste(lrt_label, "cluster", cl, coll, "ora", sep = "_"),
          width = ora_w, height = ora_h, dpi = 120
        )
      }
      if (is.null(res) || !nrow(res)) {
        cat("<p>No pathways returned.</p>\n")
      } else {
        show <- utils::head(res[order(res$padj), , drop = FALSE], 10L)
        ora_csv <- if (from_contrast_dir) {
          file.path(paste0("cluster_", cl), paste0("ora_", coll, ".csv"))
        } else {
          file.path(lrt_label, paste0("cluster_", cl), paste0("ora_", coll, ".csv"))
        }
        btn <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(ora_csv, label = "Download full CSV")
        deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(
          deseq2reports::make_gsea_datatable(show, page_length = 10), btn
        )
      }
      deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_end()
    }
    deseq2reports::bs_tabset_end()
    deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_end()
  }
  deseq2reports::bs_tabset_end()
  cat("<script>$(document).on('shown.bs.tab', 'a[data-toggle=\"tab\"]', function () { if (window.HTMLWidgets) HTMLWidgets.staticRender(); if (window.jQuery && $.fn.dataTable) { $($.fn.dataTable.tables(true)).DataTable().columns.adjust(); } });</script>\n")
}

is_hub <- is.null(params$contrast) || !nzchar(as.character(params$contrast)[1])
contrast_page <- if (is_hub) NULL else as.character(params$contrast)[1]

if (is_lrt) {
  comps <- names(params$cluster_ora_out$ora_by_lrt)
  specs <- data.frame(label = comps, class = "lrt", type = "lrt",
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  specs <- params$diffexp_out$contrast_specs
  if (is.null(specs)) {
    comps <- names(params$gsea_out$by_comparison)
    specs <- data.frame(
      label = comps,
      class = "single",
      type = deseq2reports::classify_comparison_type(comps),
      stratum_var = NA_character_,
      stratum_level = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  specs <- specs[specs$label %in% names(params$gsea_out$by_comparison), , drop = FALSE]
}
two_factor <- any(specs$class %in% c("within_A", "within_B", "interaction"))
```

```{r gsea-hub, results='asis', eval=is_hub}
cat("\n\n### ", if (is_lrt) "LRT tests" else "Contrasts", "\n\n", sep = "")
cat("Each ", if (is_lrt) "LRT" else "contrast",
    " has its own page to keep HTML size manageable:\n\n", sep = "")
if (!nrow(specs)) {
  cat("\n\nNo enrichment results available.\n\n")
} else {
  for (comp in specs$label) {
    href <- file.path(comp, paste0(comp, ".html"))
    cat("- [**", comp, "**](", href, ")\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("\n")
if (!is_lrt && !is.null(params$gsea_overlap_out)) {
  cat("Leading-edge Jaccard overlap (binary-cut clusters + word clouds) is ",
      "included at the bottom of each contrast page. Artifacts live under ",
      "`clusterprofiler/<contrast>/gsea_overlap/`.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r gsea-contrast-page, results='asis', eval=!is_hub && !is_lrt}
cat("\n\n### ", contrast_page, "\n\n", sep = "")
cat("<p><a href=\"../clusterprofiler.html\">← Back to clusterProfiler contrasts</a></p>\n\n")
emit_gsea_contrast(
  contrast_page,
  params$gsea_out$by_comparison[[contrast_page]],
  params$gsea_out$by_comparison_cp[[contrast_page]],
  coll_heading = "####",
  from_contrast_dir = TRUE
)
```

```{r ora-lrt-page, results='asis', eval=!is_hub && is_lrt}
cat("\n\n### ", contrast_page, "\n\n", sep = "")
cat("<p><a href=\"../clusterprofiler.html\">← Back to clusterProfiler LRT tests</a></p>\n\n")
emit_ora_lrt(contrast_page, from_contrast_dir = TRUE)
```

```{r overlap-contrast, results='asis', eval=!is_hub && !is_lrt && !is.null(params$gsea_overlap_out)}
comp <- contrast_page
overlap_item <- params$gsea_overlap_out$by_comparison[[comp]]
cat("\n\n### Leading-edge overlap\n\n")
cat("Per contrast, pathways with **padj < ", params$alpha,
    "** are pooled across all MSigDB collections. Pairwise **Jaccard** ",
    "similarity of leading-edge gene sets is clustered with ",
    "simplifyEnrichment **binary_cut** (to choose *k*). Splits and word ",
    "clouds cut the same Jaccard **hclust** dendrogram at that *k*, so ",
    "partition lines match the trees. The heatmap omits ",
    "pathway name labels; side word clouds summarise tokens from pathway ",
    "names within each cluster.\n\n", sep = "")

if (is.null(overlap_item)) {
  cat("\n\nNo overlap results for this contrast.\n\n")
} else {
  n_sig <- overlap_item$n_sig
  n_heat <- overlap_item$n_heatmap
  cat("\n\n", n_sig, " significant pathway(s) (padj < ", params$alpha,
      "; all collections pooled).", sep = "")
  if (!is.null(n_heat) && !is.null(n_sig) && n_heat < n_sig) {
    cat(" Heatmap shows the top ", n_heat, " by |NES|; full Jaccard matrix ",
        "is in the CSV.", sep = "")
  }
  n_cl <- length(unique(overlap_item$clusters))
  if (!is.null(overlap_item$clusters) && n_cl > 0L) {
    cat(" Binary-cut found **", n_cl, "** cluster(s).", sep = "")
  }
  cat("\n\n")

  heat <- overlap_item$heatmap
  ov_prefix <- "gsea_overlap"
  if (!is.null(heat)) {
    cat("\n\n#### Jaccard heatmap + cluster word clouds\n\n")
    sz <- attr(heat, "plot_size")
    if (is.null(sz)) sz <- list(width = 7, height = 4.5)
    device_w <- as.numeric(sz$width)
    device_h <- as.numeric(sz$height)
    if (identical(attr(heat, "plot_engine"), "pheatmap")) {
      gt <- heat$gtable
      device_w <- grid::convertWidth(sum(gt$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
      device_h <- grid::convertHeight(sum(gt$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
    }
    dpi <- 120
    px_w <- as.integer(round(device_w * dpi))
    px_h <- as.integer(round(device_h * dpi))
    img_tag <- htmltools::plotTag({
      deseq2reports::draw_pathway_jaccard_heatmap(heat)
    }, alt = paste0("jaccard_", comp), width = px_w, height = px_h,
       pixelratio = 2,
       suppressSize = "xy",
       attribs = list(
         width = px_w, height = px_h,
         style = "max-width: 100% !important; height: auto !important; display: block;"
       ))
    buttons <- list(
      deseq2reports::link_output_file(
        file.path(ov_prefix, paste0(comp, "_pathway_jaccard_heatmap.pdf")),
        label = "Download heatmap PDF"
      ),
      deseq2reports::link_output_file(
        file.path(ov_prefix, paste0(comp, "_pathway_jaccard.csv")),
        label = "Download full Jaccard CSV"
      ),
      deseq2reports::link_output_file(
        file.path(ov_prefix, paste0(comp, "_sig_pathways.csv")),
        label = "Download sig pathways CSV"
      )
    )
    cl_csv <- file.path(ov_prefix, paste0(comp, "_pathway_clusters.csv"))
    if (file.exists(cl_csv)) {
      buttons <- c(buttons, list(
        deseq2reports::link_output_file(cl_csv, label = "Download clusters CSV")
      ))
    }
    deseq2reports::emit_widget(deseq2reports::wrap_with_corner_button(img_tag, buttons))
  } else {
    cat("\n\nFewer than 2 significant pathways — Jaccard heatmap omitted.\n\n")
    deseq2reports::emit_widget(
      deseq2reports::link_output_file(
        file.path(ov_prefix, paste0(comp, "_sig_pathways.csv")),
        label = "Download sig pathways CSV"
      )
    )
  }
}
```
